## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue`. The same label rule as objectstack-ai/objectui#12212, sequenced after it

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T11:56Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3:** Home's activity card shows a raw API name beside a label. It is cosmetic.
- **Direction:** objectstack-ai/objectui#12212's rule (`6121938464`): the label in the reader's language, the API name only as the fallback. One shared component for the bell and Home, ⛔ not a second resolver.
- **Serial:** objectstack-ai/objectui#12212 is in flight (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12237) and introduces the resolver, so this card sequences after it lands. ⛔ It is not folded into the in-flight card.
- Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/console/home` (`domain:ui`); rationale: one component.

Claim: PM loop round 2 (as triage `6123772108` directs: Home's activity card names each row's object by its label in the reader's language, through the ONE component objectui#12212 introduced for the bell, ⛔ not a second resolver; the API name only as the fallback; ⛔ no label copied into `sys_activity`)
Session: `session_01G5TSaEwbEQsKMjhzTB4rEd`
Account: `os-warren`
Branch: `claude/issue-12238-home-activity-object-label`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12238`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface, on objectui `main` `08b5d97d`:
- **The card's site:** `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomeRail.tsx`, `HomeActivity`, the row's second line (`timeAgo(...) · a.objectName`).
- **The one resolver:** `ActivityObjectLabel`, module-private in `packages/app-shell/src/layout/InboxPopover.tsx` since objectui#12212 (PR objectui#12237, `fc1bc666`). It moves to one module that both the bell and Home import, unchanged in behaviour. ⛔ Not re-exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`'s entry or its barrels.
- Co-located tests: a Home pin, and objectui#12212's bell pin still green unchanged.
- `.changeset/12238-home-activity-object-label.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`).
- ⛔ No new prop, spec key or i18n key. ⛔ No change to `hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts` or `sys_activity`.
- (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui's Home activity card (@object-ui/app-shell HomeRail HomeActivity), which prints sys_activity.object_name as stored | the bell already resolves the same field through ActivityObjectLabel (objectui#12212, landed fc1bc666) | every console user with activity on Home, from the same shared feed the bell reads (render probe in the card: a crm_lead row with a Lead definition read "3 hours ago · crm_lead")`
Thread-read: 6123772108
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-10-12T13:29Z on objectui `main` `08b5d97d`:
- **The predecessor:** objectui#12212 is closed, its PR objectui#12237 merged as `fc1bc666`; `ActivityObjectLabel` is on `main` (`git grep`: `InboxPopover.tsx`, 2 hits).
- **The two files:** no open PR touches `console/home/` or `layout/InboxPopover.tsx` (9 open PRs read; the release PR objectui#11600 touches `.changeset/` only).
- **Neighbours:** objectui#12197 (`console/home/`) is `pm:on-hold` by the maintainer's ruling, not in flight. This seat's in-flight cards (objectui#12198 `AppHeader`, objectui#12234 `FlowRunner`, objectui#12228 `plugin-detail`) and seat 1's claims name neither file.
